subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The teacher encouraged students to cultivate a __________ attitude towards learning, embracing challenges as opportunities for growth.
solution:
The correct answer is '**resilient**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**resilient**" means the ability to recover quickly from difficulties or adapt to challenging situations. (लचीला)
 
• Cultivating a resilient attitude helps students embrace challenges as opportunities for growth.
 
• The other options: "**stagnant**," "**complacent**," and "**redundant**" have negative connotations and do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *The teacher encouraged students to cultivate a resilient__ attitude towards learning, embracing challenges as opportunities for growth.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Stagnant (स्थिर)**: means showing no activity or movement; dull and inactive.
 
• **Complacent (आत्मसंतुष्ट)**: means being overly satisfied or unaware of potential dangers.
 
• **Redundant (अतिरिक्त)**: means unnecessary or superfluous.
